description: Election Commission - Mrs. R. M. A. Mallika of the Haputale P/S has vacated his office of the member of that P/S - Mr. K. D. A. Kumarathunga of the Buttala P/S has vacated his office of the member of that P/S
reasoning: This gazette content contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific members have vacated their offices in Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) due to ceasing membership in their political parties. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about elected positions.
